purpose: Historical confirmed-defect recall expectations. Search pressure only; never current-artifact proof.

cases.historicalSymptom: Visible arenas exceed delivered concurrent capacity.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not assume historical capacity values apply to the current artifact.

cases.historicalSymptom: Gameplay declares/depends on remote residency but required arena residency is not created.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not treat declaration/config presence as proof of runtime ownership.

cases.historicalSymptom: Reconnect path misses a fresh-session inventory reset/clear performed by the normal path.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not infer current failure from historical handler names.

cases.historicalSymptom: Reconnect recovery conflicts with pending death/respawn ownership.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not claim ordering without source-grounded overlap.

cases.historicalSymptom: Arena can become reusable while old reset/deferred cleanup still owns mutable state.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not require runtime if source ordering already permits stale commit.

cases.historicalSymptom: Pending/retry work can escape outstanding accounting and allow premature completion or stuck progression.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not equate spawn request with completed work.

cases.historicalSymptom: Global selector/tag/state is reachable from arena-local gameplay.
cases.expectedProofMethod: Reverse state index + selector scope ownership
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not assume selector intent from naming.

cases.historicalSymptom: Ordinary player can reach a debug/skip/restart affordance.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not classify unreachable developer code as a gameplay defect.

cases.historicalSymptom: One repeated arena/region is structurally incomplete compared with the canonical baseline.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not assume physical replicas are equivalent.

cases.historicalSymptom: Two reachable terminal triggers can both commit non-idempotent consequences.
cases.forbiddenShortcut: Do not treat nearby ended-state code as Blocking Proof unless it guards the exact commit.
